CustomField.description:
This picklist is used in flows to ensure a flow is only triggered when a user with the correct setting is completing the action. Created for the Quarterly Tiering process; the person doing the tiering selects the picklist value and this ensures the flows related to quarterly tiering are triggered. Used a picklist so it could be expanded to other use cases as they arise.
S3P-1209 (S3P - 1432) - Created.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used only while completing the quarterly tiering to ensure flows trigger.
CustomField.label: Flow Trigger
